WITH scan_site_match AS (
  SELECT s.gbsize, s.spanmin, z.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites z ON s.zoneref = z.zoneregistry
),
rate_per_status AS (
  SELECT healtheval, AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin != 0 THEN gbsize / spanmin END) as avg_rate, COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM scan_site_match
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as all_status_avg
  FROM rate_per_status
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.avg_rate, r.scan_count, o.all_status_avg
  FROM rate_per_status r
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE o.all_status_avg IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_rate > o.all_status_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as avg_rate_of_kept_statuses, AVG(scan_count) as avg_scan_count, AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg) as avg_excess_over_overall
FROM filtered

assumptions.assumption: "Number of scans" per status refers to the total count of all scans in that health status, including those with missing gbsize or spanmin values

alternatives.interpretation: "Number of scans" per status refers only to scans with valid (non-NULL, non-zero spanmin) gbsize and spanmin values
